title: Panel socket
description: The WebSocket at /api/v1/socket (decision 0008 §4.6): what the panel or an agent sends (subscribe, unsubscribe) and what the runtime sends back (an envelope per event, a heartbeat every second, a refusal). Every envelope carries the ledger id and the ledger seq it reflects, except coin-icons, whose seq is its runtime-local cache counter. `since` is honoured only within the same ledger id: a `since` from another ledger id (after a backup restore or an import) gets the topic's snapshot, which the panel accepts whatever seq it held. A topic starts with its snapshot, or with the events after `since`, then its live events in order. At runtime shutdown, the socket sends a standard 1001 close (runtime stopped), so the panel marks it unreachable immediately. A client that does not complete the handshake is terminated after 250 ms. See docs/reference/runtime/api.md.

topic.description: The topic string, parameters included, as the panel subscribes it: `orders`, `positions`, `bots`, `my-trades` (data: list-frame.schema.json; `my-trades` the take-profit and stop-loss on positions and orders, decision 0011), `account-state` (data: lists-api.schema.json#/$defs/accountState), `balances` (data: balances-frame.schema.json), `ticks/<instrumentId>` (data: tick-frame.schema.json, one instrument's last price and mark, the last one first), `ticks` (the same for every watched instrument; deprecated, removed in the release after V1), `leverage/<sourceId>/<instrumentId>` (data: leverage-topic.schema.json), `candles/<instrumentId>/<resolution>` (data: chart-api.schema.json#/$defs/bar, the forming bar), `book/<instrumentId>/<rung>` with rung `finest`, `5m2`, `5m5`, `4`, `3` or `2` (data: book-frame.schema.json), `trades/<instrumentId>` (data: trades-frame.schema.json, a replay first), `md-state/<instrumentId>` (data: md-state-frame.schema.json), `asset-ctx/<instrumentId>` (data: asset-ctx-frame.schema.json), `ta/<instrumentId>/<interval>` (data: ta-rating-frame.schema.json, the TA rating of a period a DCA bot waits on), `runtime` (data: runtime-topic.schema.json, the process's state and the start-up checks still pending), `coin-icons` (data: a snapshot {epoch, versions}, then updates {coin, version}; every subscribe starts with the full snapshot, since is ignored, and seq is the icon cache's own counter, restarting with the runtime), and the demo accounts' `demo/orders`, `demo/positions`, `demo/bots`, `demo/account-state` and `demo/balances` (the same data; docs/panel/demo-accounts.md); the Trade page holds the market-data topics only while the block showing them is on screen. The runtime refuses a topic it does not serve.

subscribe.description: A second subscribe to a topic already held replaces it: one stream, starting again from its snapshot or `since`.

build.description: The runtime build stamp; a page compiled for another build reloads once.

ledgerId.description: Minted when the ledger is created; a backup restore or an import mints a new one.

seq.description: The ledger seq this event reflects; the ledger head for topics that are not ledger views (ticks, balances, leverage, candles). Never goes back within one ledger id, except coin-icons: its seq is the icon cache's own counter, restarting with the runtime; since is ignored and every subscribe gets a full snapshot.

data.description: The topic's own frame, as the topic's schema defines it.

heartbeat.description: Sent every second, so the panel's 3 s silence rule can tell a quiet market from a dead socket.

refused.description: `internal error`: the runtime failed while subscribing the topic; it is reported, and the socket stays open.
